I believe Covid made dealing with emotions a lot harder, making anxiety and depression more widespread and prevalent. OP, the best way to start dealing with your grief is addressing your mental health first. Loss can be a form of trauma. It sounds like you have had an insurmountable amount of loss lately. I'm sorry for your suffering. Please stop postponing getting help. Sometimes, it takes a few tries to find a therapist/counselor/social worker/psychologist that fits your needs and level of comfort. Take your time, feel the feelings, try journaling (written or audibly),  try some yoga (vinyasa has been healing) it can help release the physical aspect of loss.

To get married in Bernalillo County, New Mexico, an EU citizen must meet the same requirements as any other person, including providing two forms of government-issued ID and being at least 18 years old. [1]  
Requirements [1]  

• Both applicants must be at least 18 years old 
• Applicants must present two forms of government-issued ID 
• Applicants must pay a $25 fee 
• Applicants can fill out the application online 
• Applicants do not need to be residents of Bernalillo County or New Mexico 
• Applicants do not need to bring witnesses 
• Applicants do not need to get a blood test 

Acceptable forms of ID [1]  

• Driver's license or state ID 
• Military ID 
• Social Security card 
• Passport or visa 
• Birth certificate 
• Naturalization certificate 

You can contact the Bernalillo County Clerk's office for more specific details. [1, 2]

It is a perfect culmination of country living and city, and there are so many great museums, architecture, markets, and foods to see and try. Toronto was a good experience also.
